faqs.q: Where is the best place to go on a first date?
faqs.a: Choose a public place where you can talk easily and either person can leave comfortably, such as a cafe, a casual restaurant or a relaxed activity. Agree on the plan together so you both feel at ease, and if you met online, it is sensible to meet in public and let a friend know where you are going.

faqs.q: How can I tell if my date is enjoying themselves?
faqs.a: People who are enjoying a date usually ask questions, share about themselves, make relaxed eye contact and seem in no hurry to leave. Short answers, checking the time or a closed-off posture can mean they are uncomfortable. If you are unsure, simply ask how they are feeling and respect whatever they say.

faqs.q: Is it okay to kiss on the first date?
faqs.a: Only if you both clearly want to. Pay attention to how your date is responding, and if you are not sure, ask before you lean in. If they hesitate, say no or seem uncomfortable, accept it gracefully without pushing, as respecting their boundaries matters far more than any kiss.

faqs.q: How long should a first date last?
faqs.a: A first date often works best when kept fairly short, such as a coffee or a meal of an hour or two. That gives you time to talk without pressure and makes it easy for either person to end the date politely. If you both are enjoying it, you can always plan a second meeting.
